records.subject: Welcome aboard, Summit Studio
records.body:

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Summit Studio* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no key milestone. Aisha hasn't replied to either outreach ([email:bc1d432a], [email:2b5c88f0]); her only contact was a bug report (tick_b5540ba9c2ef) still open, which adds friction. Pro plan and active status are mild positives, but silence plus zero setup activity suggests low unaided activation in 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Summit Studio's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for flagging the notification badge that won't clear — your ticket is still open and Tariq is looking into it, so you'll hear back from him there.

Separately, the most useful next step in week one is getting a real project set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else as it comes up.

Best,
Chidi
